football_evidence.question: Can Tennessee take away Alabama’s big plays?
football_evidence.assessment: No material disagreement: EdgeDesk and the line are within 1.7 points.
supporting: When Alabama has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): Alabama’s offense has allowed a sack on 8.6% of its dropbacks, and Tennessee’s defense sacks the quarterback on 11.8% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.6%).
In his last two games (Auburn and Arkansas), MacIntyre averaged 8.5 yards per attempt, against 6.2 in his two games before that.
In his last two games (Mississippi State and Georgia), Russell averaged 8.7 yards per attempt, against 10.2 in his four games before that.
EdgeDesk’s position-group ratings put Tennessee’s offensive line No. 27 nationally and Alabama’s No. 112.
contradicting: When Tennessee has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): Tennessee’s offense has allowed a sack on 10.9% of its dropbacks, and Alabama’s defense sacks the quarterback on 10.1% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.6%).

When Alabama has the ball (big plays on the ground): Alabama’s offense turns 10.5% of its runs into explosive gains, and Tennessee’s defense gives up explosive gains on 6.7% of opponent runs (FBS average 6.6%).
When Alabama has the ball (the run game against the run defense): Alabama’s offense averages 6.5 yards per carry, and Tennessee’s defense allows 5.1 yards per carry (FBS average 5.1).
In his last two games (Texas and Auburn), Brandon averaged 3.9 yards per attempt, against 8.6 in his three games before that.
quarterbacks: Faizon Brandon has completed 61 of 101 passes (60.4%) for 697 yards, 6.9 yards per attempt, 7 touchdowns and 1 interception in five games for Tennessee, and has been sacked on 15 of 116 dropbacks.
George MacIntyre has completed 32 of 49 passes (65.3%) for 395 yards, 8.1 yards per attempt, 2 touchdowns and 2 interceptions in four games for Tennessee, and has been sacked on 2 of 51 dropbacks.
Keelon Russell has completed 110 of 164 passes (67.1%) for 1,599 yards, 9.8 yards per attempt, 12 touchdowns and 2 interceptions in six games for Alabama, and has been sacked on 15 of 179 dropbacks.
